title: Favorites browser authority retirement
rootCause: The favorites table and owner-scoped RLS policies already existed in staging, but the product still persisted service identifiers in localStorage.
The detail page treated the browser as the durable source of truth and did not call public.favorites.
The legacy detail experience was not loaded through an explicit dependency chain, so favorite behavior could depend on accidental script availability.

behavior.list: owner-scoped remote SELECT or non-UUID runtime memory

behavior.remove: owner-and-service-scoped remote DELETE or non-UUID runtime memory

matrix.controlledFutureDescription: Browser-persistent favorites authority must remain retired and public.favorites must be the canonical authenticated authority.
